title: Dahuang Huanglian Xiexin Decoction Ameliorates Obesity by Targeting the PPARgamma/STAT3/PTGS2 Axis: Integrative Network Pharmacology and Experimental Validation.
authors: Gu, Huan; Yang, Lichang; Hao, Long; Li, Mingxi; Li, Ji
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究中药复方抗肥胖机制，虽涉及蛋白靶点对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Childhood obesity is a major preventable health issue. This study evaluated the anti-obesity effects of Dahuang Huanglian Xiexin Decoction (DHXD) and explored its potential mechanisms using network pharmacology and molecular docking. Active compounds and targets of DHXD were identified from TCMSP and HERB databases, while obesity-related targets were obtained from GeneCards, TTD, and DisGeNET. A protein-protein interaction network helped identify 45 shared targets and 10 hub genes. Molecular docking confirmed strong binding between DHXD components and key targets. An obesity rat model was established using a high-fat diet, followed by DHXD treatment. Parameters such as body weight, fat mass, and rectal temperature were monitored. Biochemical assays and histological staining assessed metabolic and tissue changes. Western blotting evaluated the expression of obesity-related proteins. Results showed DHXD significantly reduced body weight and fat accumulation, improved blood glucose and lipid profiles, and promoted lipolysis and browning of white adipose tissue. Molecular analysis highlighted PPARgamma, PTGS2, and STAT3 as central targets mediating DHXD's anti-obesity effects. These findings support the potential of DHXD as an effective therapeutic agent against obesity and provide insights into its molecular mechanism of action.
abstract_zh: 儿童肥胖是一个主要的可预防健康问题。本研究评估了大黄黄连泻心汤（DHXD）的抗肥胖作用，并利用网络药理学和分子对接探讨其潜在机制。从TCMSP和HERB数据库中鉴定了DHXD的活性化合物和靶点，而肥胖相关靶点则从GeneCards、TTD和DisGeNET中获取。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络帮助识别了45个共享靶点和10个枢纽基因。分子对接确认了DHXD成分与关键靶点之间的强结合。通过高脂饮食建立肥胖大鼠模型，随后进行DHXD治疗。监测了体重、脂肪量和直肠温度等参数。生化检测和组织学染色评估了代谢和组织变化。Western blotting评估了肥胖相关蛋白的表达。结果显示，DHXD显著降低了体重和脂肪积累，改善了血糖和血脂谱，并促进了白色脂肪组织的脂解和褐变。分子分析强调PPARgamma、PTGS2和STAT3是介导DHXD抗肥胖作用的核心靶点。这些发现支持DHXD作为对抗肥胖的有效治疗剂的潜力，并为其分子作用机制提供了见解。
